leadIn: After completing this lesson, you will be able to:
objectives: Implement a heartbeat function that periodically sends status updates to a server
Initialize a presence tracking state to monitor user activity status
Configure event listeners to detect user presence changes (active/idle/away)
Construct a client-side presence manager that coordinates heartbeat and status updates
Integrate presence logic with a simulated server API to send and receive status data
Manipulate the DOM to display real-time user presence status based on activity
Control the heartbeat interval and manage cleanup to prevent memory leaks
lessonTitle: Build heartbeat and presence client logic
